scripts.dev: node apps/api/scripts/asegurar-env.mjs && concurrently "pnpm --filter api dev" "pnpm --filter web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter api build && pnpm --filter web build
scripts.db:migrate: node apps/api/scripts/asegurar-env.mjs && pnpm --filter api prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: node apps/api/scripts/asegurar-env.mjs && pnpm --filter api prisma db seed
scripts.db:studio: node apps/api/scripts/asegurar-env.mjs && pnpm --filter api prisma studio
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter api typecheck && pnpm --filter web typecheck
